purpose: Names of the ZH-channel nuisances in vh_ws/zh_channel_inputs.json, chosen to follow the A3 correlation scheme (correlated = lumi, photon efficiency, lepton efficiency, photon energy scale / m_gg resolution, theory scale+PDF of common processes; uncorrelated = MC statistics, channel-specific normalisations). WH names are those of wh/scripts/stat_lib.py (lumi, pheff, lepeff, phscale, phres, scale_<group>, pdf_sig). The A3 owner may rename; ZH inputs carry the key 'name' for every nuisance, so a rename is a one-line mapping.

lumi.basis: ASSUMPTION (same as WH); frozen ZH LUMI_UNC = 2.5 %

pheff.applies: all processes with real photons: +-4 % (two real photons: signal, other Higgs, Zgg, top), +-2 % (one real photon: F_QCD_Zajj, F_EW_Zajj)
pheff.basis: ASSUMPTION, 2 % per photon as in WH 06_systematics. NEW with respect to the frozen ZH study (which reweighted CMS-like efficiencies, no nuisance)

lepeff.basis: ASSUMPTION, 1 % per lepton as in WH (two leptons here). NEW with respect to the frozen ZH study

phscale.applies: signal-like samples S_EW_ZHjj and WH signal in the ZH SR: m_gg x (1 +- 0.005)

phres.applies: signal-like samples: m_gg = mu + (m_gg - mu)(1 +- 0.10), mu = 125.06 GeV

scale_sig.applies: S_EW_ZHjj (and the WH signal in the ZH SR is NOT given this name: it carries the WH value)
scale_sig.basis: QCD-scale envelope of the EW VH signal family, work/theory/theory_summary.json S_EW_ZHjj (region R, n=18664)

scale_hqcd.applies: H_QCD_ZHjj (scale and PDF added in quadrature, total 0.33)

scale_higgs_other.applies: H_ggZH (0.274), H_ttH and H_tHW (0.296), H_ZH_tautau (0.330, QCD ZHjj proxy): each process with its own relative value, one common parameter as in WH

scale_efake_qcd_ll.wh_note: ZH_Zajj_eFake QCD part is the same frozen sample

scale_top_zh.basis: frozen th_top. RENAMED from scale_fake1_qcd (R3 fix 2): WH uses scale_fake1_qcd for its fake1_qcd group (F_QCD_Wajjj, T_tta_1l, T_tWa_1l: single-lepton top samples and a W gamma jjj sample); the ZH T_tta/T_tWa are the dilepton samples, a different process/sample, so no correlation is imposed

fakerate.basis: D39; in addition the ZH-only zh_norm_<sid> keeps the frozen 50 % per-process normalisation (hypot with the calibration difference), so the ZH fake rows are not tighter than frozen

zh_offshell.basis: frozen off-shell/FSR correction uncertainty (ZH-only: the WH Zaajj lost-lepton rows use the frozen sample but no such nuisance)

zh_norm_<sid>.hi_lo: up = 1 + r, down = 1/(1 + r) (log-normal-style, symmetric in ln; R3 fix 5: the former floor 1 - r >= 0.001 made the F_EW row one-sided)
zh_norm_<sid>.applies: per process: 10 % (prompt, resonant) or 50 % (fake-photon rows; hypot(0.5, FFD) with the calibration difference for the corrected rows, F_EW also hypot(0.5, 1.5) after the D3 closure fix)
zh_norm_<sid>.basis: frozen per-process normalisation; a ZH-only name because the processes differ from the WH classes. Same SAMPLE in both channels (F_QCD_llajj_vbs in the ZH SR and in the WH eFake row) is a decision for A3 (frozen samples, but different regions and different normalisation models).

mcstat_zh.applies: all processes, one per m_gg bin (Barlow-Beeston-lite, err_bin = sqrt(nu_bin e^2/y) so that the sum equals the total MC uncertainty of the process estimate)
mcstat_zh.basis: MC statistics are uncorrelated between channels

tau_r_decision.argument: tau_r in WH is the +-100 % uncertainty of the W->tau nu -> l nu feed-down uplift r_tau = 0.083 (D9) of the W leptonic samples. The ZH-channel rows have the Z decaying to ee/mumu in the ME with a 25 GeV Z-mass window, no W. Z->tautau->(ee,mumu) same-flavour OSSF pairs relative to Z->ee+mumu are BR(Z->tautau) x [BR(tau->e nunu)^2 + BR(tau->mu nunu)^2] / BR(Z->ee+mumu) = 0.0337 x (0.1782^2 + 0.1739^2) / 0.0673 = 0.31 % before any cut, and their m_ll is shifted well below the Z window, so the effective uplift in the ZH SR is below 0.3 %, 30 times smaller than r_tau = 0.083; +-100 % of it is a sub-per-mille effect on the ZH rows and is not modelled (H->gg ZH(tautau) is its own sample, H_ZH_tautau). Therefore no tau_r in the ZH channel. RECOMMENDATION to the WH side: tau_r is applied by WH to the ZH-sample rows that sit in the WH SR (ZH_*_lostlep, ZH_Zajj_eFake, ZH_Zaajj_*); for those rows the relevant tau effect is the Z->tautau->l + lost lepton topology, not the W r_tau = 0.083, so the name should be channel/process specific there (e.g. tau_r_zrows) rather than the shared tau_r, or the uplift for these rows should be derived separately. Not edited by the ZH executor.

signal_like_samples_in_ZH_channel: S_EW_ZHjj (scaled by mu_VH / mu_ZH and by the ZH coupling dependence)

NONE in the fit: the WH signal in the ZH SR has zero MC support (0 raw events in 300k): it is recorded as a stated bound (UL95 events at 500 fb^-1) in zh_channel_inputs.json['wh_signal_in_zh_sr'] and is not a sample of the ZH channel (R3 fix 3)
